name: Duck Mountain Provincial Park - Pickerel Point Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19, Pickerel Point only (Birch, Poplar, Spruce): every paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. Esri World_Imagery z18 (0.37 m/px) with SKPP GIS points for all 83 Spruce and 99 Birch sites: Spruce's point sites S68-S83 run down the west side of the wooded point; pixel profiles put the tree crowns 16-22 m west of S68, S70, S74, S77, S79 and S83 and open water about 25-35 m out (flood-fill mask to deep water 41-55 m), under continuous spruce/aspen canopy. SKPP site photos (read 2026-11-19): the lake shows through the trees from S70, S74, S77, S79 and S83 (S83's second photo from the bank), not from S68. S55 (~15 m from the bay over open sand) is posted 18 ft only. Birch's west row (B7-B29) sits about 30-55 m from the lake through continuous forest, and B29-B33 behind forest and a wide reed and driftwood flat on the north bay; Poplar is inland. No 23-ft-capable site on open ground to the water. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290275, read 2026-11-19 (whole-park paging table, 381 rows, + detail pages for all 83 Spruce, 99 Birch and every 3rd Poplar site): Pickerel Point - Birch 204 (77 Nightly Electric + 2 Accessible + 4 Double, 15 Nightly Full Service B192-B206, 106 seasonal), Poplar 59 Nightly Electric, Spruce 82 Nightly Electric + 1 seasonal (S15) = 346 site-specific sites, 239 by the night; 207 nightly sites take a unit of 23 ft or more (maximum equipment 25-50 ft). Group sites Deer, Elk and Moose not counted. Fern (now its own entry) and Selwood (11 non-electric sites, all 18 ft or less) excluded. --Claude
note: Provincial-park campground on Pickerel Point on Madge Lake near the Manitoba border, in boreal forest: the Birch, Poplar and Spruce loops, Spruce running out along the wooded point between the lake and a bay. Fern, the park's winter-camping loop about 2 km southwest by the park village, has its own entry. Selwood, 11 non-electric sites about 2.5 km north on its own road, books only units up to 18 ft. About 107 sites, nearly all in Birch, are sold by the season, and 16 nightly Spruce sites take units of 18 ft or less. --Claude

season.note: 2026 dates. Full services May 14 to September 30; October camping on electric sites with portable toilets, booked through the park office. Winter camping is at Fern.

fees.note: $4 a night less from October 1, with reduced services.

curation_note: Split 2026-11-19: this id kept Pickerel Point (Birch, Poplar, Spruce; 346 sites), whose stored pin it already marks (71 m from S14, at the entrance hub between the loops). Fern (F1-F19 + yurts, centroid 51.64044,-101.62687) became a new entry, measured 2.01 km to the Pickerel Point centroid (1.72 km to Spruce, 2.30 km to Birch; nearest sites F12-S83 1.24 km) on its own access road off Highway 57 (5.9 km by road), and runs the winter camping. Selwood (SW1-SW11, centroid 51.67768,-101.61021) is 2.45 km north on its own 3.3 km road and books only units up to 18 ft, so it has no entry and is left out of the counts. Within Pickerel Point the loops are 0.36-0.78 km apart on one road. --Claude
